entries.source_quote: Crystallize - raises an impassable wall of ice for 5 seconds, physically blocking movement and pathing
Glacial Storm - channelled blizzard field that chills and slows enemies for as long as Anivia channels it
Summon: Tibbers - deploys Tibbers who persists for ~45s contesting and threatening the area around him with aura damage
Arise! - summons sand soldiers that persistently attack and zone an area around their position
Emperor's Divide - raises a wall of soldiers that blocks movement and displaces enemies, reshaping pathing
Tempered Fate - freezes all objects in a large area for 2.5 seconds, creating a contested zone that cannot be safely crossed or fought through
Infernum or Crescendum off-hand turret placement contests ground around its fixed position; weapon-loadout dependent
Falling Star / The Skies Descend - creates a large slowing/stunning field on the ground that persists briefly
Between Worlds - creates a Spirit Realm arena that slows and constrains movement within it for its duration
Twilight Shroud - deploys a ring of smoke that obscures vision and slows enemies who enter, contesting the area
Volley - fires a cone of arrows that slow enemies in the area; brief but creates a denial cone enemies cannot safely advance through
Yordle Snap Trap: places up to 3 armed traps on the ground that root and briefly reveal enemies who step on them; traps persist for 30 seconds and zone enemies from areas or cage them near objectives
Hextech Ultimatum: creates an impassable force field arena around the target that traps them and prevents enemies from entering or leaving the zone
Miasma: creates a lingering poison cloud that slows and grounds enemies inside it, preventing the use of movement abilities for the duration
Parallel Convergence: after a delay a time-distortion field appears that slows enemies inside it and stuns those caught when it fully activates, denying the ground for several seconds
Crowstorm: channels then blinks to location and deals persistent AoE damage in a large radius around Fiddlesticks for the full channel duration, making the entire area lethal to stand in

Chum the Waters: the traveling shark creates a large slowing field around it as it approaches the landing point, denying ground for the full travel duration; the landing AoE knockup additionally scatters grouped enemies

Glacial Fissure: smashes the ground in a long line knocking up enemies hit, then leaves a lingering crevasse that slows enemies who walk over it for several seconds, persistently denying the ground corridor
Certain Death: fear-marks all visible enemies and pulls them all toward Briar's landing point, forcibly repositioning the entire enemy team and clearing or contesting a zone around impact
Rupture: erupts a target ground area after a delay, knocking up and silencing all enemies caught in the zone; forces enemies to evacuate the targeted area on sight or be launched
Valkyrie: Corki dashes and leaves a burning fire trail behind him that deals persistent damage to enemies who stand in it, lingering on the ground for a few seconds
Powder Keg - places explosive barrel on ground; barrel sits until detonated or destroyed, denying movement through the area
Cannon Barrage - calls sustained cannon fire on a large area for several seconds, making the ground dangerous and forcing repositioning
Explosive Cask - scatters enemies outward from impact point, clearing and controlling space around the explosion
H-28G Evolution Turret - places autonomous turrets that contest and hold ground, attacking enemies that enter the area
Tormented Soil (QE) - leaves a lingering ground zone that damages and slows enemies who remain in the area
Test of Spirit - pulls enemy spirit out; spirit location spawns additional tentacles, creating a contested zone around the extracted spirit
Daisy! - summons Daisy the golem who holds and contests space, knocking up enemies in her path and controlling the area around her
Monsoon - channels for up to 3 seconds, continuously knocking back all nearby enemies, clearing and denying the area around Janna for the channel duration
Cataclysm - creates an arena of impassable terrain walls trapping enemies inside, physically reshaping pathing for its duration
Captive Audience - places a lotus trap on the ground that slows then detonates; sits dormant denying safe passage through the area until triggered or expired
Prophet of an Elder God - periodically spawns a Tentacle on nearest terrain that persists and attacks enemies commanded by abilities, holding ground around walls
Leap of Faith - slams idol spawning one Tentacle per champion hit (up to 6) for 8 seconds; supercharged attack frequency saturates the area with damage
Vanguard's Edge - blades form a spade-shaped perimeter for 2.5 seconds; enemies crossing for the first time are slowed 90% for 1.5 seconds, functionally sealing the boundary
Smoke Screen - canister creates a smoke cloud for 4 seconds applying persistent nearsight to all enemies within, denying vision and forcing repositioning out of the area
Lightning Field (melee form) - surrounds Jayce with an electric field for 4 seconds dealing magic damage per second to nearby enemies, contesting melee space
Jinx tosses out 3 Chompers that snap shut on the first enemy that walks over them, rooting and dealing damage
All Out knocks the target enemy champion through terrain into an isolated area behind it, separating them from their team
Mantra-empowered Q Soulflare leaves a Circle of Soulflare that deals damage and slows all enemies within it after a brief delay
Defile: when toggled on, drains mana to deal damage to all nearby enemies each second, creating a persistent damaging aura around Karthus
Wall of Pain creates a line zone that slows enemies passing through and reduces their magic resistance for several seconds; does not block pathing
Slicing Maelstrom summons a storm that repeatedly strikes enemies around Kennen for multiple seconds, creating a heavily contested area
Lamb's Respite marks a circular zone on the ground; no unit inside can die, creating a spatially contested sanctuary/denial area
Chaaaaaaaarge! leaves a trail of fire along the charge path that deals damage and slows enemies who cross it
Lucent Singularity leaves a slowing field on the ground for several seconds before detonation
Unstoppable Force crashes into an area, knocking up all enemies hit and scattering them from the impact zone
Void Swarm voidlings weakly contest nearby space but primarily chase a designated target rather than holding ground
Sapling Toss plants a sapling that arms after a short delay and explodes when an enemy approaches
Nature's Grasp sends a slowly advancing root-wave that denies the corridor in front of it for several seconds as it travels
Realm of Death banishes Mordekaiser and his target into an isolated realm, removing both from the main map entirely
Tormented Shadow creates a lingering damage pool on the ground that burns enemies standing in the area
Bullet Time channels a barrage of bullets in a cone, creating a sustained zone enemies must exit or be shredded
Naafiri commands her packmates - hound units that pursue and contest the area around marked targets
Tidal Wave sends a massive wave that knocks up and displaces all enemies in its path, clearing a wide lane of space
Cozy Campfire places a healing aura zone on the ground that allies stand in, passively contesting and discouraging enemy approach to that area
Cyclone spins Wukong in a wide area dealing repeated knockups, creating a moving zone enemies cannot safely stand in for the channel duration
Bushwhack: places a trap that reveals and damages enemies who trigger it; sits dormant until sprung or it expires
Absolute Zero: large channelled snowball field that slows and deals heavy damage to all enemies remaining in the zone for the channel duration
Command: Dissonance leaves a lingering AoE field around the ball that slows enemies and speeds allies for several seconds

Call of the Forge God: a massive ram entity charges across the map twice, knocking up and displacing all enemies in its path; the moving collision clears space but does not create static impassable terrain
Steadfast Presence: creates a zone around herself that passively and actively prevents enemy dashes from completing within the area
Soaring Slam: creates a tremor zone on impact that repeatedly knocks up enemies who remain in the area for several seconds
Tunnel: digs a burrowed tunnel entrance/exit on the ground that persists until destroyed; physically alters pathing and map structure at placed locations
Magnet Storm: creates a large magnetic vortex around herself that continuously pulls nearby enemies inward, denying escape from the area for the duration
Duskbringer: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that leaves a lingering Dusk Trail on the path; enemies standing on the trail are slowed and Nocturne gains movement/attack speed while on it
Equalizer lays a long-duration line of fire zones that slow and damage, denying ground for ~8s
Glacial Prison blizzard lingers at impact point, slowing enemies in the area for several seconds
Jack In The Box sits dormant up to 60s, fears and slows enemies who enter, denying brush and jungle paths
Dragon-form Flame Breath leaves a burning flame field on the ground for several seconds
Poison Trail leaves a lingering poison cloud behind Singed while he runs, denying corridors and jungle paths
Mega Adhesive creates a placed field for 3 seconds that grounds enemies within and slows them, denying movement-ability use in the area
Smolder breathes a cone of flame that leaves a lingering fire patch on the ground dealing damage over time
Seismic Shove displaces enemies in a target direction, clearing space in a short burst - a spatial scatter rather than impassable terrain
Weaver's Wall raises a massive impassable wall across the map, physically reshaping pathing for its duration
Noxious Trap places invisible mushrooms that persist on the ground, slowing and poisoning enemies who trigger them
Pillar of Ice creates an impassable terrain pillar at the target location for a duration, blocking movement
Wingborne Storm creates a lingering storm around Udyr that deals damage in an area, denying close approach
Threaded Volley leaves Worked Ground on the terrain for several seconds; enemies moving through it face reduced rock hits, marking and altering the ground state as a lingering spatial zone
Demonic Ascension creates a persistent draining AoE field around Swain while toggled, pulling and damaging all nearby enemies for the duration, contesting the surrounding ground
Event Horizon: pentagon cage of impassable walls that stun enemies crossing the edge and deny a zone for ~3s
Death Ray: leaves a lingering Aftershock field on the path that damages and slows for ~4s
Dark Procession: ring of impassable walls that cages or quarantines a zone for ~4-5s
Eulogy of the Isles: summons the Maiden of the Mist who autonomously pushes and denies a lane
Rite of the Arcane: repeated barrages onto targeted ground zones, denying area through damage threat
LIFE FORM DISINTEGRATION RAY: channelled beam sweeping across ground for ~2.5s, denying approach
Stormbringer: lightning continues striking in the area around Volibear for the duration after landing
Crescent Guard: displaces all non-Challenged enemies out of the area around Xin Zhao, denying a contested zone for ~0.75s
Gravity Field: placed gravity mine on ground that slows all enemies inside; 3 stacks stuns for 1.5s, persists ~4s
Wind Wall: large impassable wall that blocks all enemy projectiles for ~3.75s, denying a corridor of ground for ranged approach
Sanguine Pool: Vladimir submerges into a ground AoE that slows and damages enemies standing over it for ~2s
places a Starfall Lotus on the ground that blooms, dealing damage and slowing enemies in the area
calls down a massive celestial lotus that detonates across a large area, creating an extended zone of damage
scatters a cluster of mines over an area; mines slow and damage enemies who walk through them until triggered or expired
Satchel Charge places an armed explosive on the ground that enemies must avoid; the charge sits dormant and denies the area around it until detonated or expired
Sleepy Trouble Bubble leaves a lingering puddle on the ground where it lands, slowing and threatening to sleep enemies who walk through it
Rampant Growth places a seed that sprouts into an attacking thornspitter plant, contesting and denying the area around it
Stranglethorns erupts a large thorn zone that knocks up enemies and leaves a briefly lingering area of thorns denying the space
Final Chapter channels ~3.75s sending 7 repeated waves of magic that root all enemies caught in the wide cone, denying the area in front of Yuumi's host for the channel duration
